evidence: The text states: 'The opals were grown on thin glass slides so that after infiltration they could be released with HF, allowing us to examine both the top and bottom surfaces of the film.' Additionally, it mentions: 'Calculations of size and size distribution for the population were obtained from the purified products by measuring the size of at least 100 particles in transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images.' Furthermore, it notes: 'The size of the crystalline domains estimated from the width of the X-ray diffraction (XRD) peaks was 3.5 to 4 nm for both the as-prepared and heated samples.'
